vulnerability_analysis: The mint function increases _tTotal without adjusting _rTotal, causing the reflection rate (rTotal/tTotal) to decrease. When the rate decreases, the same reflection amount converts to more tokens via tokenFromReflection(). This creates an arbitrage where minting tokens to oneself increases the token balance disproportionately.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the owner to gain minting privileges. 2. Mint a large amount to the attacker address. 3. The decreased reflection rate makes the attacker's reflection balance worth more tokens. 4. Verify the attacker's token balance increased significantly.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 2. Call mint() with a substantial amount. 3. Check the attacker's token balance before and after to demonstrate profit.
